description: This Java source file defines a class 'ModifyAclEntrySubstitutionStrategy' that handles substitution logic for ACL entries within modify commands in a system related to authorization and headers. It specializes a generic substitution strategy to modify ACLs based on headers and authorization subjects.

classes.name: ModifyAclEntrySubstitutionStrategy
